description: MAIN-PARA's EIBCALEN = 0 guard at :172-174. No communication area travelled, so the program cannot know who called it: :173 moves 'COSGN00C' into CDEMO-TO-PROGRAM and RETURN-TO-PREV-SCREEN transfers at :548-551 without sending a map and without handing one record to the queue. The area carried forward is this program's own initial CARDDEMO-COMMAREA with only the three fields :543-547 writes set, and CDEMO-PGM-CONTEXT back at ZEROS. EIBAID is never read on this path, so no AID is declared: declaring one would suggest the key mattered. Expected values are STATICALLY DERIVED by reading app/cbl/CORPT00C.cbl, its copybooks, app/bms/CORPT00.bms and app/csd/CARDDEMO.CSD - never captured from a COBOL run, which is impossible in this environment (risk R-A). Java has no transient data queue, so EXEC CICS WRITEQ TD QUEUE('JOBS') at :517 is reproduced through an explicit job-submission port; the eighty-byte content is identical and the dataset key JOBS names the TDQUEUE(JOBS) that app/csd/CARDDEMO.CSD:499-505 defines as RECORDSIZE(80) RECORDFORMAT(FIXED) BLOCKFORMAT(UNBLOCKED) DISPOSITION(MOD).
